name: linux-doctor
surface: desktop app + exported dashboard (one frontend, two faces)

world.summary: A professional Linux desktop tool: sidebar + rows, one accent, density with air.

craftBar.for: sidebar + rows; recognizable as a Linux app

world.commitment: Execute the canon at full fidelity, without irony and without smuggled quirk.

rules: One accent with exactly three jobs: primary action, selected row, focus.
Severity is the only other colour on screen.
No per-item cards for findings; findings are rows.
No hard-coded colour outside base.css (print.css excepted).
tabular-nums for every number in a column
uppercase only for labels, never for sentences

components.name: headerbar
components.notes: full-bleed, identity as two lines, one primary action, inset hairline highlight

components.name: rail
components.notes: Health block on top, then section blocks separated by hairlines

components.name: health
components.notes: score, progress hairline, headline, counts line, freshness; no gauge, no KPI tiles

components.name: toolbar
components.notes: sticky under headerbar; segmented group-by, severity pills, search, icon+label buttons

components.name: toolbar-icons
components.notes: CSS masks from one 13px single-stroke set; survive JS label changes

components.name: row
components.notes: severity dot with halo, title, mono code / NEW, chevron; hover is a surface change

components.name: detail-pane
components.notes: master-detail; below 1200 the row expands inline

components.name: status-bar
components.notes: view, freshness, read-only promise, keyboard map

components.name: command-palette
components.notes: views, actions, in-memory findings; arrows move, Enter runs, Esc closes

components.name: skeleton
components.notes: shape of incoming content on load instead of a spinner

components.name: empty-state
components.notes: short sentence + a way out (e.g. Clear filters)

a11y.motion: short and directional; fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

do: pair empty states with an action
dont: red left border on a card
